purpose: Say that an action cannot reach full completion.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
One person cannot finish this amount of food.
I cannot read all of it in one day.
restrictions: Often the amount or difficulty exceeds capacity; differs from simple inability to begin.
mistake: 食べ切れない means cannot eat all of it, not cannot eat any.
